out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at BACK PREP handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PLEASE PROVIDE A HAND SOAP DISPENSER AND FORWARD A PICTURE TO EHS WIHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. LIVE FLIES WERE OBSERVED IN BACK PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT PEST CONTROL SERVICE AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WIHTIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A CHEMICAL MIXING DISPENSER CONNECTED DOWNSTREAM OF ATMOSPHERIC VACUUM BREAKER AT MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED THE PICTURE OF BACKFLOW PREVENTERS WITH CFM. PLEASE INSTALL A BACKFLOW PREVENTER ON THE MOP SINK AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.
